capabilities.ui: business web app and reviewer renderer

limitations: Category changes, expiry warnings and points expiry happen only when Infra applies their events; the App never schedules itself.
Points are earned only by Waypoint transfers in; paid stays do not earn points and there is no elite status.
Notices are built for Mail by harbor.notices.outbound; Infra publishes them through Messaging.
Payment labels are opaque; charges are recorded locally, not posted to a card App.
